build_semsegseqnet: build a SemSegSeqNet model with RGB, depth, and semantic segmentation encoders for object navigation
build_semsegseqftmodel: build a SemSegSeqFTModel with action distribution output for imitation learning training
build_objectnavilpolicy: build an ObjectNavILPolicy from config for object navigation with critic network support
extract_sge: extract the semantic goal embedding from observations to compute goal object visibility ratio
freeze_visual_encoders: freeze the RGB, depth, and semantic segmentation encoders in the policy for fine-tuning
